The '''''Sun Runner''''' was a 400-meter-long [[Corellia StarDrive]] [[Alpha-class heavy transport|''Alpha''-class heavy transport]] that went missing around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], when the [[Margrave Octan]] of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] transported his family and 867 [[colonist]]s to the [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Because the Margrave was a member of a ruling family known as the [[Royal Octans]]—which had obtained their wealth as [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]]—he carried aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] three [[power gem]]s that were able to disrupt [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic defense shields]]. His ancestors had used these same power gems to overtake enemy ships and seize their property.<ref name="SWA:HTSR">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

The colonial transport vanished when it attempted to make a supply run to the nearby planet [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] only a week after the colonists arrived on the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]]. The ship&mdash;identifiable by its distinguishing mark of a golden circle divided by a single white line&mdash;and its three precious power gems—known thereafter as the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]]—were never found in subsequent searches. Having [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the jungle-moon, the Margrave's ruling descendants and the people of Nallastia and Fondor continued to search for the starship over the next four millennia.<ref name="SWA:HTSR" />

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] created a derelict [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit]] of the vessel in a scheme to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] and surface factories.<ref name="SWA:HTSR" />
